emma_cs: Quick FYI — Skyline Health wants a short demo uplift next Friday. They rotate IPs; requesting header allowlist + EU+LATAM routing.

ravi_support: What QPS and windows? header or CIDR?

emma_cs: They estimate 200 sustained, 375 peak for a 3.5h window: 2026-08-13 14:00-17:30 UTC. Prefer header pin x-skyline-demo. AE @ae_julia flagged this as high-priority for renewal.

zoe_eng: Plan: header allowlist + soft qps bump, route to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1, pin model to v2-small to keep latency predictable. Need KV warmup 25m before start with warmup prompts from AE.

todd_oncall: Ops guardrails: 10% canary for 10m, autorevert default 72h, alerts: p50>220ms OR 5xx spike>1% -> page oncall. Also add per-session token ceilings to avoid DoS.

ravi_support: Draft rollout summary to apply:
- target regions: eu-west-1, sa-east-1
- allowlist: header x-skyline-demo=demo-aug2026
- rate override: qps=375, burst=650
- canary: 10% for 10m -> promote to 100% if healthy
- autorevert: 72h (AE can request extension)

ravi_support: Pushing to staging canary now.
deploy-bot: change-request 3642001234: applying header allowlist + route override to staging canary (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 3642001245: staging canary healthy after 10m. No errors.
ravi_support: Promoting to prod; scheduling autorevert 72h out; allowlist TTL 7d for troubleshooting. Ticket CS-1842 created with rollout and contact list.
deploy-bot: change-success 3642001298: prod override applied to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. Smoke checks passed.
emma_cs: Added runbook and renewal note to customer file. AE to confirm header value and provide warmup prompts.
todd_oncall: Runbook link: https://playbooks.internal/skyline-demo-runbook (internal).
emma_cs: Will follow up with AE and close this thread after demo outcome. :thumbsup:
